## Contribution type

- [ ] Model artifact metadata
- [ ] Hardware preset
- [ ] Reproducible benchmark evidence
- [ ] Documentation or UI

## Source and license

Link the upstream source and state its license/attribution requirements.

## Evidence checklist (required for a `verified` claim)

- [ ] Exact artifact ID and quantization
- [ ] Hardware SKU/configuration and usable memory policy
- [ ] Runtime name, version, and sanitized command/configuration
- [ ] Context, concurrency, prompt throughput, and decode throughput
- [ ] Link/topology details for any multi-node run
- [ ] No secrets, IP addresses, hostnames, private paths, or raw prompts
